content.title: How to watch the Sidemen Charity Match on TV for free - start time and teams
content.text: The hugely popular event is returning to Wembley Stadium for the second successive yearThe Sidemen Charity Match returns to Wembley Stadium for the second successive year this weekend, with some of the most popular creators on YouTube descending on the home of English football.Having previously been staged at St Mary's Stadium, The Valley and the London Stadium, the Sidemen had no problem filling Wembley for last year's event, and have sold it out again with 90,000 tickets being bought in just three hours.The event has raised over £8 million for charity across its previous six editions and has now raised a further £4.7 million for the Bright Side and M7 Education charities through ticket sales for this year's match.It will see members of the Sidemen - the YouTube group comprised of Olajide Olatunji (KSI), Simon Minter (Miniminter), Josh Bradley (Zerka), Ethan Payne (Behzinga), Harry Lewis (W2S), Tobi Brown (TBJZL) and Vikram Barn (Vikkstar123) split across two teams, Sidemen FC and the YouTube Allstars.They will be joined by other online creators, including I'm A Celebrity...Get Me Out of Here! winner Angry Ginge and Strictly Come Dancing finalist George Clarke to battle it out for the trophy.Here's everything you need to know about Saturday's match, including kick-off time, how to watch and the line-ups in full.Kick-off timeThe match kicks off at Wembley Stadium at 3pm on Saturday, April 18.How to watchThe charity match will be available to watch for free on the Sidemen's official YouTube channel.Launched in 2016 for the inaugural charity match, it became the fastest channel to reach one million subscribers.Today, the channel's subscriber count is over 23 million.Who is playing in the Sidemen Charity Match?Sidemen FC:Manager: Jack Joseph0 – Deji3 – Marlon4 – Zerkaa7 – Arthur TV9 – Aminematue10 – ChrisMD12 – xQc14 – Adapt19 – Jynxzi21 – TBJZL22 – Niko23 – AB30 – AJ Shabeel61 – LazarBeam67 – Lacy77 – Wroetoshaw123 – Vikkstar123YouTube AllstarsManager: Calfreezy1 – Sketch2 – WillNE4 – KSI5 – CarryMinati7 – Miniminter8 – George Clarkey9 – Max Fosh11 – Ibai13 – AngryGinge14 – Squeezie15 – MrWhoseTheBoss17 – Nykchazza25 – Behzinga28 – Danny Aarons66 – Stable Ronaldo88 – ItalianBach99 – JasontheweenPrevious resultsOver the last six years, The Sidemen have the better overall record, with four wins compared to the YouTube Allstars' two.2016: Sidemen 7-2 YouTube Allstars2017: Sidemen 0-2 YouTube Allstars2018: Sidemen 7-1 YouTube Allstars2022: Sidemen 8-7 YouTube Allstars2023: Sidemen 8-5 YouTube Allstars2025: Sidemen 9-9 YouTube Allstars (YouTube Allstars win 5-4 on penalties)
